work_trace_mutation_result_input.description: Read the immutable original mutation result payload retained under this caller's idempotency identity. A fragment grants no complete pin or intent authority; reconstruct, verify the byte length and SHA-256 digest, then validate the original operation result schema before use.

json_fragment_page.description: Exact whole-code-point UTF-8 fragments of one captured canonical JSON result payload. Digest hashes the complete original payload bytes, not an envelope. Join contiguous offsets, verify total bytes and digest, parse once, and validate the source schema before using authority. envelope.next_cursor advances an incomplete document.

cursor_output.description: Output readback continuation cursor. The store mints cursors with no encode-time length guard, so the readback carries no maximum; authored page input keeps the bounded cursor definition.

retained_work_id.description: Output readback of retained stored work identity and workflow-type reference text. The work.created fold stores the event subject verbatim as work_items.id and the workflow-type ref inside intent_json with presence-only checks, the message, relation, and observation folds store endpoint work identities the same way, and work_items carries no id CHECK, so the readback carries no maximum and no pattern; authored work and workflow-type identifiers keep the bounded id definition.

retained_work_text.description: Output readback of retained work intent text: the title and captured note the summary echoes. The work.created and work.intent_revised folds copy these fields verbatim with presence-only checks, work_items.title carries no length CHECK, and intent_json is unbounded text, so the readback carries no maximum; authored intent text keeps the bounded short definition.

retained_project_id.description: Output readback of retained stored Project identity echoed in work project memberships. The project.created fold stores the event subject verbatim as projects.id with a presence-only check and projects carries no id CHECK, so the readback carries no maximum; authored Project identifiers keep the bounded id definition.

lifecycle.description: Observed work lifecycle state for outputs and read-side filters.

lifecycle_transition_target.description: Agent-requestable lifecycle transition targets. The superseded state is retired: supersession beyond the one-live-item-per-Linear-issue rule is gone. reopen returns a completed or cancelled item to needed through the work.reopened fold.

cancelled_instance_closes.description: All-time count of work items in this item's primary Project that have lifecycle completed while their workflow instance is cancelled (the CD-0183 D4 repair route).

relation_query_label.description: Labels the relation read surface serves. Derived from contracts/relation-vocabulary.v1.json: every kind's forward label, plus each declared inverse label.

workflow_law_context.description: The approved contract's binding law and Domains, resolved at read time from the committed law folder and Domain registry. Absent when the contract binds no law and no Domain.

registry_path.description: The repository path of the Domain registry shard. Present when the context binds at least one Domain.

workflow_law_context_law.description: A bound law at the verified own-home snapshot. An absent law retains only identity, roles, obligation IDs and status absent; reserved additions carry identity and roles before publication. Present laws carry readable current metadata.

roles.description: Every binding role the approved contract gives the law, sorted and deduplicated.

obligation_ids.description: The contract's verification obligations that name the law, sorted and deduplicated. Present only when roles carries obligation.

kind.description: The law kind its law-folder tier supplies. Constitution records are law, so a contract can mandate them.

resume_read_result.description: The complete resume document when it fits, otherwise authenticated lossless JSON fragments. Reconstruct the entire document and verify its digest and byte length before validating resume_read_document and using it.

resume_read_document.description: The item's stored step plan, derived next step ids and work version. Before intake, opening_steps contains intake and pick_type; after proceed it contains pick_type, and after any other intake outcome it is absent. After type pick, next_steps derives from the stored plan. Every type requires clarify; fix requires diagnose first. Terminal items carry neither next_steps nor opening_steps.

repository_mode.description: The Project's repository mode. On means Concord's files are committed like Product files; off means agents keep them out of git as specified by CD-0255.

version.description: The work version written by the retained effect, qualified by version_work_id; never a page index.

depth.description: Hops from the requested work item. An edge at depth 1 is stored. An edge at a greater depth is derived by same-kind closure, which only a transitive kind admits.

requested_budget_seconds.description: CD-0038 D1: caller-requested operation budget in whole seconds, minimum 1. Model-visible intent in the canonical request digest; the only agent-facing operation budget. Exceeding the operation ceiling refuses before any effect rather than clamping. Accepted shape: integer; Bounds: >=1 value inclusive; example: 1

reference.description: A workflow reference list item with no Unicode White_Space characters and 2-128 UTF-8 bytes. Slashes are allowed because touched refs name repository paths. target_project_id.description: The receiving Project the handoff addresses. The source Project and session come from the authenticated call context, never from this input. Bounds: 1..128 code points inclusive

bounded_job.description: The bounded repository job the receiving session executes; not a whole-work resume instruction. Bounds: 1..4000 code points inclusive

next_action.description: The exact next action the receiving session takes first. Bounds: 1..1000 code points inclusive

artifact_refs.description: Immutable sha256:path references into the authenticated source checkout; each digest is verified against the real file bytes. Bounds: <=16 items inclusive

handoff_id.description: The recorded handoff to bind. The consuming Project and session come from the authenticated call context; a wrong-target or stale consume refuses. Bounds: 1..128 code points inclusive

already_recorded.description: True when a same-content replay resolved the recorded handoff from state with no event.

already_consumed.description: True when the same receiving session's standing bind replays with no event.

state.description: ready_to_close_or_replace requires the recorded handoff, preserved artifacts, and no unfinished workflow action of the session; pending names the open blockers.
